{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Salad Recipes|Salad Recipes]]

==Ingredients==
=== Variation I ===
* 1 large can (12 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]]) [[Cookbook:Tuna|tuna]]
* 1 can [[Cookbook:Water Chestnut|water chestnuts]], drained and [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]]
* ½ small [[Cookbook:Onion|onion]], chopped
* 1–2 stalks [[Cookbook:Celery|celery]], chopped
* ½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Carrot|carrot]], shredded
* ½ cup [[Cookbook:Mayonnaise|mayonnaise]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoon]] [[Cookbook:Dijon Mustard|Dijon mustard]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] [[Cookbook:Soy Sauce|soy sauce]]
* [[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]] to taste
* [[Cookbook:Pepper|Pepper]] to taste

=== Variation II ===
* 1 can [[Cookbook:Tuna|tuna]], drained
* 2 tablespoons [[Cookbook:Mayonnaise|mayonnaise]]
* ¼ small [[Cookbook:Onion|onion]], chopped

=== Variation III ===
* 1 large can (12 oz) [[Cookbook:Tuna|tuna]]
*2 cups [[Cookbook:Mayonnaise|mayonnaise]]
* 1 large bag shredded [[Cookbook:Cheddar Cheese|cheddar cheese]]
*3 [[Cookbook:Grape|grapes]], chopped
*4/3 [[Cookbook:Hot Dog|hot dogs]], roughly chopped
*4 bags tater-tots, just barely defrosted

==Procedure==
#Mix all ingredients in a bowl.
#Chill before serving.
#Serve on toast.
